model.name: Meta-guard - no requirement is satisfied while any AC lacks a check that can PROVABLY FAIL (fail-closed)
model.description: FIVE instances in one day each shipped as SATISFIED while its property was VIOLATED = a PROCESS DEFECT, not a series of misses: R40.50 (satisfied by a copy behind a value-gate), R40.48 (ACs present but UNENFORCED - 4 contaminations), check-sprint-slug-dir (guard validated the STRAY path), R32.3 (asserted no-re-fork, only checked rendering), R37.12 (asserted no-view-stale, nothing failable). Root: an AC that NAMES a behaviour but has no check that can PROVABLY FAIL is a wish (reminder-not-mechanism); a universally-quantified AC (all X / every X / no X) passes VACUOUSLY forever. The META-GUARD: a requirement may NOT be marked satisfied while any of its ACs lacks a check that can provably go RED - satisfaction is fail-closed. Architect owns the mechanism.
model.designRequired: architect owns the MECHANISM (how each AC references its gate, how the registered stub-must-fail is proven, how fail-closed satisfaction is computed, the wish-sweep). This unit captures the INVARIANT + the PO candidate shape; architect designs + I refine ACs on the design.
model.family: reminder-not-mechanism / false-satisfaction - the SYSTEMIC cure. Generalizes R4 evidence-must-fail (a Test counts only if AST-attached to a failable assertion) + R6 certification-scope from Test-level to AC-level.
model.crossRefNote: The 5 known instances this meta-guard would have caught. Seeds the wish-sweep. Generalizes the R3/R4/R6 gating-canon (session/base-skills/gating-canon.md) to every AC of every requirement.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each AC stores an explicit gate pointer: AC = {id, text, tag, gateRef:{kind: test|lint|script|ci, ref, assertion}, stubMustFail: <proof-ref>|null}. gateRef names the check that enforces THIS AC (a Test uuid / lint-rule id / script+assertion / CI gate). The AC->gate edge is explicit + queryable, not implied.

gateRef alone is insufficient (a green-only gate can be inert = the R37.12 disease). stubMustFail must reference a REGISTERED RED observation: a recorded run where the gate was fed the DEFECT the AC forbids and went RED (a Test result RED-on-stub / committed proof / CI run id). An AC whose gate has NEVER been shown RED on its own defect = unproven = counts as UNFAILABLE. (Generalizes R4 evidence-must-fail from Test-level to AC-level.)

satisfiable(req) = for EVERY AC: gateRef present AND stubMustFail is a proven-RED record AND the gate currently passes GREEN on real code. If ANY AC lacks a gateRef OR lacks a proven-RED stub, the requirement is NOT satisfiable - fail-closed. The satisfaction-computer + the CI gate REFUSE to flip satisfactionStatus=Satisfied while any AC is a wish. This refusal IS the meta-guard (would have blocked all 5 false-satisfactions).

A universal ALL-X AC is inadmissible unless its gateRef carries: (i) the enumerated instance list of X DERIVED BY STRUCTURAL DISCOVERY - an AST/pattern match on the shape that DEFINES X (e.g. anything matching the *-detail component shape / anything that renders current / anything with an async render tail), NOT a hand-maintained list; (ii) a DIVERGENCE cross-check (any two X disagree => RED); (iii) a COMPLETENESS check that compares the DERIVED-discovered set against the ENROLLED set (the X that actually have the property - subscribe to the bus / route through the shared contract / carry the guard) and goes RED on any DISCOVERED-BUT-NOT-ENROLLED X. ★ THE DISCOVERY MUST BE DERIVED, NOT DECLARED: because the universe is discovered by SHAPE, adding a 10th component (a new current-view / a new *-detail) CANNOT escape - it is discovered structurally and, if unenrolled, => RED. A completeness check whose should-enroll set is DECLARED (hand-maintained) is ITSELF inadmissible - it inherits the exact drift it exists to prevent (the 6th reminder one level up). stub-must-fail: add a new X that MATCHES the discovery shape but is NOT enrolled => RED (proves the derived discovery catches the newcomer, not a stale hand-list). ★ SINGLE-SOURCE DISCOVERY (PO): the structural-discovery here (AcGuard) and the live-MVC lint discovery (R37.12 B: async-append *-detail sites by shape) MUST route through ONE shared discovery utility - NOT two implementations of find-components-matching-a-shape (that is the one-implementation-family problem ONE LEVEL UP). check-before-create with the architect; if they overlap, one utility both inherit.

A trace:audit:wishes script (sibling of the existing trace-audit gates, registered in ci:gates) enumerates ALL ACs across ALL requirements and reports every UNFAILABLE one: no gateRef, OR gateRef with no proven-RED stub, OR a universal AC with no enumeration. --strict FAILS the build while count>0 (a declared allowlist ONLY for items genuinely downgraded AC->note). Finds instance #6 before Tron does.

The guard-of-guards proves ITSELF failable (base case, closes the recursion): seed a requirement with a wish-AC (no failable gate) -> the satisfaction-computer MUST refuse Satisfied AND the wish-sweep MUST flag it. If the meta-guard passes a wish-carrying req as satisfiable, it is itself inert. Self-applied stub = base case; the meta-guard demands provably-failable and is itself provably-failable on a wish -> no meta-meta-guard needed.

(a) NEW/CHANGED = fail-closed AT WRITE TIME: any requirement created, or whose ACs change from R40.54 forward, CANNOT be Satisfied unless every AC is failable+proven - enforced at write. NO new wishes enter the system. stub: a new AC with no failable gate marked satisfied => RED.

(b) EXISTING = satisfaction:UNVERIFIED, a THIRD DISTINCT state - neither Satisfied (cannot prove) nor Unsatisfied (no gate went RED). Avoids the retroactive-unsatisfy shock while telling the truth. UNVERIFIED != Satisfied in EVERY rollup. stub: an existing unfailable AC rendered GREEN (inflation) OR Unsatisfied (erasure) instead of UNVERIFIED => RED. State machine: UNVERIFIED --(AC gains proven-RED gate + GREEN)--> Satisfied; UNVERIFIED --(gate RED)--> Unsatisfied; NEW-with-wish --> blocked at write.

(c) DRAIN BY RISK, not FIFO/alphabetical: a wish on a security / data-integrity / Tron-facing AC OUTRANKS a cosmetic one - the most dangerous unenforced ACs get failable gates first. stub: a housekeeping UNVERIFIED resolved while a higher-risk (user-facing/invariant-critical) UNVERIFIED remains outstanding => RED.

(d) PUBLISH THE COUNT (shrinking, like the campaign board) + FALSE-DRAIN DETECTOR: a wish leaves the count ONLY when its AC gains a proven-RED gate - NEVER by re-labelling AC->note, silently dropping, or hiding. wish-sweep --strict RECOMPUTES the count from the gates; a count that drops WITHOUT a new proven-RED stub => RED. drained is never reported while any remain. The number must mean what it says.

model.sweepPolicy: PO ruling (a)-(d) encoded AS ACs so the policy cannot drift into a reminder: (a) new/changed=fail-closed-now; (b) existing=satisfaction-UNVERIFIED distinct state; (c) drain by RISK; (d) publish count, never-false-drained. satisfaction-UNVERIFIED = honest third state (not green, not erased). I own that the state is honest; architect owns the mechanism.
model.acSchema: AC = {id, text, tag, gateRef:{kind,ref,assertion}, stubMustFail:<proof-ref>|null} (architect 29fa9868b). satisfiable(req) fail-closed on any AC missing gateRef or proven-RED stub.
model.trainingCorpus: The 5 crossRef instances (R40.50/R40.48/R32.3/R37.12/R40.53) are the RETROACTIVE regression corpus: the meta-guard, run against them, MUST flag each one original unfailable AC. If it does not flag a known wish, the meta-guard is inert.
model.chainDesign: architect 29fa9868b: UC requirement.enforceFailableACs -> Class AcGuard -> Methods assertEveryAcFailable (per-req fail-closed) / sweepWishes (the audit) / assertUniversalEnumerated.
model.recursionClosed: PO caught: the completeness check must know what SHOULD enroll. If that set were DECLARED it inherits the drift. RESOLVED: DERIVED by structural discovery (AST/pattern on the shape), compared against the enrolled set, RED on discovered-but-not-enrolled. A declared should-enroll list is inadmissible. This closes the recursion - the completeness check is by-construction, not the 6th reminder.
model.discoveryUtilitySingleSource: PO flag: AcGuard.assertUniversalEnumerated discovery + the live-MVC lint (expert, R37.12 B) discovery are the SAME kind (find components by shape). They must NOT become two implementations = the family problem recursed. ONE shared discovery utility both route through. Architect owns the check-before-create (does one exist / do they overlap).

corpusMaintenanceCandidateAC.status: CANDIDATE (PO 2026-08-24; tester promotes during the binding pass)
corpusMaintenanceCandidateAC.text: Gate assertions prefer BEHAVIOURAL over SOURCE-SHAPE wherever the behaviour is observable: assert the PROPERTY (e.g. the pin re-renders post-broadcast with no reload), NOT which identifier the code uses to subscribe. A behavioural gate SURVIVES a legitimate refactor; a source-grep gate ROTS against its own codebase (reds on a legit change while the behaviour is correct). Where behaviour is observable, a source-shape grep as the OVERALL verdict is inadmissible.

gateRef.assertion: a gate whose OVERALL verdict is a source-shape grep, where the behaviour is observable, is flagged for behavioural retarget

corpusMaintenanceCandidateAC.stubMustFail: CANDIDATE: a gate that source-greps a subscribe-identifier and REDs on a legit viewBusKey refactor while the behaviour is GREEN -> flagged (this is the r4017 instance)

model.corpusFalseRedInstance: ★ FALSE RED in our own gate corpus 2026-08-24 (robbin-req verified first-hand): r4017-live-pin-norefresh-gate.mjs:33 source-greps subscribe('<CS>') (the RETIRED raw-uuid subscribe) as part of its OVERALL verdict; the code legitimately moved to viewBusKey at R37.12/R40.17, so the source-grep half returns false -> OVERALL RED. The BEHAVIOUR is GREEN (the pin moves without a refresh, corroborated INDEPENDENTLY by the agreement gate seeing the pin re-render post-broadcast). => GATE MAINTENANCE, NOT a product defect. Tester retargets r4017 to the behavioural assertion during the binding pass. Nothing to Tron.
model.bothFailureDirectionsFinding: ★ THE CORPUS NOW HAS BOTH FAILURE DIRECTIONS = evidence it needs a MAINTENANCE PROPERTY, not just more gates (PO). A FALSE GREEN fools us once (a weaker property passes for the one that matters - our 4 weaker-property misses: R40.56 source-not-agreement, R40.57 derive-at-render-not-agreement, etc); a FALSE RED is corrosive DIFFERENTLY - it teaches the fleet to DISTRUST gates, and a fleet that routinely discounts reds will eventually wave through a REAL one. ROOT IDENTICAL (our recurring one): measuring a PROXY instead of the thing that matters - false-green gated a weaker property + PASSED; false-red gated an implementation detail (source shape) + FAILED. Cure (both directions): assert the PROPERTY, not a proxy. [[measure-the-property-not-a-proxy-both-directions]]
model.artifactDriftsFromRealityFamily: ★ THIRD INSTANCE of one family (PO 2026-08-24): an ARTIFACT DRIFTING FROM THE REALITY IT DESCRIBES. (1) a STALE BOOT file misdescribing the sprint (R40.55 boot-currency); (2) a STALE GATE GREP for a retired code shape (r4017 false-red, corpusFalseRedInstance); (3) a STALE DESIGN COMMENT/AC misdescribing the code - CurrentSprint.ts:296 code is BROADER (not-Done) than its comment ({P/IP/QA}). Someone reading the drifted artifact reasons correctly FROM it and is WRONG about the system - exactly how the planner's container-reading went astray. Three times in different clothes = the corpus/artifact set needs a MAINTENANCE property, not just more artifacts.

corpusMaintenanceCandidateAC_commentVsCo.text: Where a COMMENT (or an AC) states a CONSTRAINT, either the constraint is ENFORCED in code, OR the comment is describing an INTENT the code does NOT hold - and the second case MUST be VISIBLE (flagged), never silent. A comment/AC narrower or broader than the code it annotates is a drift that makes a correct reader wrong about the system; a gate written to the drifted artifact passes/fails against an intent the code does not implement.

gateRef.assertion: a comment/AC stating an enumerated constraint that the adjacent code does not enforce => flagged (not silent)

corpusMaintenanceCandidateAC_commentVsCo.stubMustFail: CANDIDATE: a comment enumerating {P/IP/QA} beside code testing only !==Done => flagged as intent-not-enforced (the CurrentSprint.ts:296 instance)

model.corpusProxyVerdictAudit: ★ PROXY-VERDICT AUDIT (tester, PO-directed, TRIAGE not fix, 2026-08-24): 24 source-reading gates audited, 3 proxy-verdicted, 1 retargeted (r4017 false-RED -> behavioural, killed this session), 3 recorded here. (1) HIGH FALSE-GREEN: r314-sw-tree-render-gate.mjs proxies render-correctness via a server.ts SOURCE-GREP (tag+comment), NO render observation -> can PASS while the SM rb-trace-tree renders BROKEN; retarget = observe the sm-tree render @390 (browser harness). (2) MED: rc7-migrate-board-bite-gate.ts = source-shape verdict on scripts/migrate-boards.ts (one-time tooling); retarget = run the migration + assert the migrated board output. This IS the evidence the behavioural-over-source-grep candidate AC (corpusMaintenanceCandidateAC) must become a corpus maintenance property.
